base.text: Aura: Your Units have +4 attack, Rush and First Strike.

radiant.text: Aura: Your Units have +10 attack, Rush and First Strike.

base.text: After you play a card, shuffle 3 copies of it into your deck.

radiant.text: After you play a card, shuffle 3 Radiant copies of it into your deck.

base.text: Your cards gain "Combo X: Deal X damage to the enemy hero." X = cards you played earlier this turn.

radiant.text: Your cards gain "Combo X: Deal 2X damage to the enemy hero." X = cards you played earlier this turn.

base.text: Start of turn: Choose one: Exile the bottom card of your deck, lose 3 health, or summon a Spikey Pillow.

radiant.text: Start of turn: Choose twice: Nothing, exile the bottom card of your deck, lose 3 health, or summon a Spikey Pillow.

base.text:
Your hero can't take more than 5 damage at once.
Cry: Draw 1.

radiant.text:
Your hero can't take more than 3 damage at once.
Cry: Draw 2.

base.text:
Aura: Your opponent can't draw more than {drawLimit|card|cards} each turn.
When your opponent plays a Book, you may Tribute this to steal it.

radiant.text:
Aura: Your opponent can't draw more than {drawLimit|card|cards} each turn.
When your opponent plays a Spell, steal it. Once the Spells this has stolen cost ({threshold}) or more in total, Tribute this.

base.text:
Cry: Exile a ({costLimit}) Cost or less Spell from your hand.
Activate: Cast a copy of that Spell.

radiant.text:
Cry: Exile a ({costLimit}) Cost or less Spell from your hand.
Activate: Cast a copy of that Spell.

base.text: At the start of each player's turn: Destroy every permanent that player controls with a Plague Token on it.

radiant.text: At the start of your opponent's turn: Destroy every permanent they control with a Plague Token on it.

base.text:
End of turn: Discard 2 cards.
Whenever you discard cards, draw that many.

radiant.text:
End of turn: Discard 2 cards.
Whenever you discard cards, draw your deck.

base.text:
This enters with X Plague Tokens on it.
Aura: Counter every card played whose cost equals the number of Plague Tokens on this.

radiant.text:
This enters with X Plague Tokens on it.
Aura: Counter every card your opponent plays whose cost equals the number of Plague Tokens on this.

base.text: Cry and start of turn: Summon a Right-house defender (2 in 3) or a Wrong-House Attacker (1 in 3).

radiant.text: Cry and start of turn: Summon a Right-house defender and a Wrong-House Attacker.

base.text:
Cry: Give your Units Divine Shield.
Aura: Your Units have +{aura}/+{aura}.

radiant.text:
Cry: Give your Units Divine Shield.
Aura: Your Units have +{aura}/+{aura}.

base.text: Cry: Exile {cards|random card|random cards} from your deck. Summon the Units among them.

radiant.text: Cry: Exile {cards|random card|random cards} from your deck. Summon the Units among them and make them Radiant.

base.text: Cry and end of turn: Choose a card in your hand. Fuse a random card into it. Its cost doesn't change.

radiant.text: Cry and end of turn: Choose a card in your hand. Fuse a random Radiant card into it. Its cost doesn't change.

base.text: Death: Add {cards|Stockpile|Stockpiles} to your hand. Each costs (0).

radiant.text: Death: Add {cards|Radiant Stockpile|Radiant Stockpiles} to your hand. Each costs (0).

base.text: Start of turn: Add {fruits|random Fruit|random Fruits} to your hand. Each costs (0).

radiant.text: Start of turn: Add {fruits|random Radiant Fruit|random Radiant Fruits} to your hand. Each costs (0).

base.text: Start of turn and end of turn: Upgrade {cards|random other card|random other cards} in your hand or on your side of the field. Degrade {cards|random card|random cards} in your opponent's hand or on their side of the field.

radiant.text: Start of turn and end of turn: Upgrade {cards|random other card|random other cards} in your hand or on your side of the field. Degrade {cards|random card|random cards} in your opponent's hand or on their side of the field.

base.text: End of turn: Add {cards|random AI generated card|random AI generated cards} to your hand. Each costs (0).

radiant.text: End of turn: Add {cards|random Radiant AI generated card|random Radiant AI generated cards} to your hand. Each costs (0).
